biggest_catch: The £100/£75 split is a limited-time boost running 14 September to 6 October 2026 — outside that window the standard £50-each offer applies, so this route's payout is only guaranteed within the stated window.
catches: Boosted campaign: referrer £100, friend £75, valid 14 September to 6 October 2026 only; standard offer outside the window is £50 each.
Credits are applied only after the friend has switched AND both of you have made a payment to EDF (typically ~4 weeks).
If either account closes before the credit is applied, the referral is cancelled.
The referral link must be used at quote time; if the friend switches without it, you must contact EDF for a manual credit.
Refer a Friend cannot be combined with any other prospective customer promotional offer.
Residential and Small Business customers can refer, but only residential properties can be referred.
UK only; confirm the program is still current before sharing.

payout_quote: From 14 September to 6 October 2026, every time you successfully refer a friend to EDF using your referral link, they'll get £75 and you'll earn £100.
payout_value_note: Referrer £100 (≈$133) / friend £75 (≈$100) account credits during the 14 Sept–6 Oct 2026 window; offsets planned energy spending (savings).

steps: As an existing EDF customer, share your referral link with a friend.
The friend uses your link to complete a new quote and switches to EDF.
The friend switches and both of you make a payment to EDF.
Both accounts are credited automatically: £100 to you, £75 to the friend.
timing: Accounts are credited automatically once the friend has switched and both of you have made a payment (typically ~4 weeks).
